comments.author: bakabaka
comments.body: Someone can clarify what great effects those firepits give for resting around it?

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: Taxes for trade goods are reduced by 50% for 30 mins.

wiki:
Benefit: It is related with
Effect: Tax Reduction

Duration: for 30 mins

First, use the item.
Second, Sit or kneel near the bonfire with your fleet members for about 20 sec. and you and the other fleet players can trigger the effect.
You can check the termination time at Journal>Special Item Effects in game.
